name: Gomoku (Five in a Row) — enforced
description: Black and white stones on a 15×15 board. First to make an unbroken row of five — in any direction — wins. The engine enforces turns, one stone per point, and the win.

place.reason: Place your own stone on an empty point, on your turn.

win.result: {player} wins with five in a row!

rules.objective: Be first to place five of your stones in an unbroken line — horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.
howToPlay: On your turn, drag a stone onto an empty intersection — it snaps to the nearest point.
Stones never move once placed; occupied points and out-of-turn plays are refused.
rules.winning: Exactly five (or more) in a row wins. A completely full board with no five-line is a draw.
